subject: Initial seller setup & buyer intake — action list
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Rao <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial seller setup & buyer intake — action list

Hi Asha,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier — excited to get LumenHealth set up so we can start routing POs and invoices on the new engagement. To speed vendor creation, could you please return the items below (we can accept PDFs or secure links):

1) Legal entity name and address (as registered)
2) Completed W-9 (or W-8 variant if non-US) — PDF
3) Remit-to email for invoices and preferred invoice file format (PDF/invoice XML)
4) Bank letter or voided check showing account name + ACH/wire details (routing & account number; SWIFT if applicable)
5) Example invoice(s) showing your invoice numbering and line-item layout

Optional, but helpful: company tax ID (EIN), copy of vendor registration form, and any procurement terms (master PO instructions). Our Finance team requires a bank letter for ACH verification before we enable auto-payment.

Target timeline: if we can get these by EOD Monday (Nov 30), Finance will create the vendor record and I’ll confirm when POs can be issued (typically within 2–3 business days after verification).

I attached a short buyer-intake checklist (link below) — feel free to upload documents to the Drive folder or reply with attachments.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LumenOnboarding

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marcus and Dev for any procurement/finance questions.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Buyer, Procurement
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Buyer_Intake_Checklist.xlsx (stated attachment stub)

If LumenHealth plans to accept both ACH and wire, ask them to include SWIFT for wire reconciliation.

Thanks — attaching the items you requested. Please see the attached: LumenHealth_W9.pdf (completed), LumenHealth_BankLetter.pdf (bank confirmation on letterhead), and a zip of sample invoices (LumenHealth_InvoiceSamples.zip).

Key remit details:
- Remit-to email: accounts-payable@lumenhealth.com
- Bank: First Meridian Bank
- ACH routing: 111000025, account ending 6789 (ACH)
- Wire: ABA 111000025, SWIFT: FMBBUS33
- Legal entity: LumenHealth, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789)

We typically invoice against Redwood POs and our standard terms are Net30. We can accept PO attachments via email or SFTP — please confirm your preferred PO receipt method.

Also linking our vendor registration portal for any additional forms: https://vendor.lumenhealth.com/register (we attached a filled copy of our buyer intake form as well).

Let me know if you need notarized bank confirmation or additional tax docs.

Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial seller setup & buyer intake — action list

Asha — thanks, received everything. Next steps from our side:

1) Finance will validate the bank letter and W-9 (Dev is on point). Expect a confirmation email from payments-team@redwoodinference.com within 24–48 hours.
2) Once validated we’ll create the vendor record and set remit-to to accounts-payable@lumenhealth.com.
3) Procurement will issue the first PO; POs typically get generated 1–3 business days after vendor activation. We will send POs to the remit-to email and attach the PO PDF.

Can you confirm preferred PO receipt method (email vs SFTP) and whether LumenHealth requires a specific invoice reference (PO number + project code)? If Net30 is your standard, that works for us — we’ll include payment terms on the PO.

I’ve also created a DocuSign envelope for the standard vendor agreement and SOW; signing speeds up PO issuance: https://app.docusign.com/verify/ABC-ONBOARD-4821

Thanks again — I’ll update the HubSpot record after Finance completes verification.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Buyer, Procurement
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: Redwood_Buyer_Intake_Checklist.xlsx (already shared), onboarding Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LumenOnboarding
